jobs.how: Each boiler on the Master profile has its own On/Off BV: boilers 1-4 are BV 162-165. Check the boiler shows as detected on the bus before commanding it.

points.use: Write boiler 1 on/off; check it's writable on the controller
Write boiler 2 on/off; check it's writable on the controller
Read boiler 1 detected on the bus
Read central heat call

jobs.how: Target Mode selects which target applies; then write Setpoint Target, Target temperature or Target Mod Rate. The manual does not document the Target Mode values, so confirm the result on the read-back AIs.

points.use: Write target mode (values undocumented); check it's writable on the controller
Write target water setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Write target water temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write target modulation rate; check it's writable on the controller
Read the current target water temperature
Read the current target firing rate

jobs.how: System-level values sit at the top of the list on every VERSA IC device. No units or state texts are given, so check readings against the boiler display.

points.use: Read system supply water temperature
Read outdoor air temperature
Read setback state
Read central heat call
Read system pump state

jobs.how: Each boiler has a 29-point block: boiler 1 is BI 17 to AI 45, boiler 2 starts at BI 46, boiler 3 at BI 75, boiler 4 at BI 104. Flow sensor and flame current sit separately at AI 166-174.

points.use: Read boiler 1 outlet water temperature
Read boiler 1 inlet water temperature
Read boiler 1 vent (flue) temperature
Read boiler 1 modulation rate
Read boiler 1 ignition status code
Read boiler 1 flow sensor value
Read boiler 1 flame current

jobs.job: Outdoor reset and warm weather shutdown
jobs.how: The outdoor reset curve is set by outdoor start/design and boiler water start/design. Warm weather shutdown has separate occupied and unoccupied values. These are boiler settings; do not rewrite them cyclically.

points.use: Write outdoor start temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write outdoor design temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write boiler water start temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write boiler water design temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write occupied WWSD temperature; check it's writable on the controller
Write unoccupied WWSD temperature; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: DHW, tank and pool each have a setpoint, a differential and an unoccupied on/off BV. Read DHW Call and DHW Temperature to confirm the DHW side is working.

points.use: Write DHW tank setting; check it's writable on the controller
Write DHW differential; check it's writable on the controller
Write DHW priority on/off; check it's writable on the controller
Read DHW tank temperature
Read DHW call
Write tank setpoint; check it's writable on the controller
Write pool setpoint; check it's writable on the controller

jobs.how: Each boiler reports an active error code plus 15 history entries. The manual gives no code list, so log the number and look it up in the boiler documentation.

points.use: Read boiler 1 active error code
Read boiler 1 error history entry 1
Read boiler 2 active error code
Read boiler 1 ignition status code
Read boiler 1 detected; alarm if it drops out

checklist: Set the ProtoNode S-bank DIP switches: all off for BACnet IP (default), or S0 on for BACnet MS/TP with the MAC (1-127) on the A-bank and the baud on B0-B3.
Wire the ProtoNode to the master VERSA IC only, at Modbus RTU 19200 baud, with a unique node ID on each unit.
Open the Web Configurator (default IP 192.168.1.24), add a Master profile per VERSA IC (Follower profile for cascade followers) and change BN_Node_Offset if 50000 clashes.
Discover each VERSA IC as its own BACnet device: instance = offset + Modbus node ID (node 10 = 50010 by default).
Read BI 17 (Blr 1 detected), AI 2 (System Supply Temperature), AI 18 (Blr 1 Outlet temperature) and AI 23 (Blr 1 Mod Rate) and compare them with the boiler display.
Confirm BV 162 (Blr 1 On/Off) is writable, then switch it and watch AI 25 (Blr 1 Ignition Status) and AI 23 respond.
Set BV 134 (Target Mode) with AV 135 (Setpoint Target) or AV 160 (Target Mod Rate) and check AI 14 / AI 15 show the target you meant, since the mode values are undocumented.
Program the BMS to write boiler settings only on change, never cyclically.
Map AI 30 (Blr 1 Error Code) and BI 17 for each boiler as alarms, using the matching points in the boiler 2-4 blocks.
